verdict.rationale: Retell's docs describe a built-in knowledge base: you can crawl a website or upload documents for the agent to retrieve from. The CLI manages knowledge bases, Conductor inspects their sources and indexing status, and AI QA scores knowledge-base accuracy. However, the evidence is mostly one-line overview mentions, with no dedicated knowledge-base documentation showing how retrieval grounds answers. missing for 10: a dedicated knowledge-base/RAG doc covering supported file types, chunking, and retrieval configuration; detail on how grounding works at answer time; independent or hands-on corroboration that answers come from uploaded content.

support.subject: As a developer, I can ground the agent on my documents with a built-in knowledge base or RAG so it answers from my content

citations.quote: Crawl a website or upload documents your agent retrieves from.
Retell agents are node-based flows or single prompts, with call handling, a knowledge base, and integrations built in.
Conductor can inspect your knowledge bases, their source metadata, and indexing status.
Install the Retell CLI to manage agents, phone numbers, knowledge bases, and other Retell resources from your terminal with simple commands.
